faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes R350 use?
faqLeft.a: The R350 uses the M272 3.5‑litre V6 petrol engine, fitted across the entire production run from 2006 to 2013.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes R350 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed‑price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my R350?
faqLeft.a: The R350 always uses the M272 - but we'll confirm your exact specification via registration to ensure we've matched all ancillary details correctly.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M272 R350 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M272 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used R350 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low‑mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my R350 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an R350 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3‑5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most R350 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12‑month unlimited‑mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
